query: I have been paying my home loan for two years and want to close it early. Will I be charged a foreclosure fee? It is a floating rate loan.
answer: Hello! For your floating rate loan, the foreclosure charge depends on your borrower category and loan purpose. If you are an individual borrower, the foreclosure charge is Nil. Additionally, as required by regulation, no foreclosure charge is levied on floating rate loans sanctioned to individual borrowers for purposes other than business. If you are a non-individual borrower, the charge is 4% of principal outstanding. Goods and Services Tax applies to all charges.

query: How do I update the mobile number registered on my loan account?
answer: To update your mobile number, submit the request through the mobile app, the customer portal, or a branch, and verify it with an OTP sent to your existing registered mobile number. If your existing number is no longer accessible, you must update it in person at a branch with an original officially valid document. The change takes effect within 2 working days. Please note that only one mobile number change request is permitted in any 30 day period.

query: My EMI auto debit failed last month. What charges will I have to pay?
source: FAQ-EMI-03 / What happens if my EMI payment bounces?
answer: A bounce, also called a dishonoured mandate or a failed auto-debit, attracts a bounce charge of Rs. 500 per instance, plus applicable GST. This is separate from late payment interest. If an auto-debit attempt failed, the bounce charge still applies.

query: Can I move my EMI date to the 20th of every month?
source: FAQ-EMI-03 / Can I change my EMI due date?
answer: No, you cannot move your EMI date to the 20th. The available due dates are the 1st, 5th, 10th or 15th of the month; no other date can be selected.
